messages.content: Help me write a post-apocalypse RPG adventure around this idea: The player characters are scavenging a corporate complex, and they encounter a pair of deactivated android replicants. These are machines programmed to act as CEOs, but only they can open up a stash of pre-War technologies.  Use only words with lengths that are prime numbers.

message.content:
After war RPG quest.

Strip the corpo complex. See two deactivated android CEO units. The two deactivated android CEO units are replica units. The two units ask for oil. Oil is low. Offer oil to the two units. The two units start. The panel glows. The vault opens. The vault holds old techs. The old techs are power tools. No other may release the stash. Release old techs.

Hazards include ash smoke drone guard panel fault rusty hatch.

Aim to get old techs. The stash has traps.
